Callout.Name: Perimeter Wall - Fresh Marks
Callout.Message: Fresh marks found on the perimeter wall.
Callout.Advisory: No persons present, lighting failed on one stretch.

Script.Line: The marks are fresh. The brick dust is still on the ledge.
The lights are out along that stretch and have been since Tuesday.
Whoever did it will be back. They always come back.

Lines.Approach: Fresh marks and the lights out along that stretch. Somebody is testing it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
